title: Bolo gelado de leite em pó com geleia de frutas vermelhas
creator: cantinho_al21

items.note: mixed with water, to soak the cake
for dusting, instead of a brigadeiro topping

steps: Cake: whisk the eggs, sugar and vanilla in a stand mixer until very pale and creamy.
Add the oil, warm milk, flour and baking powder and mix on low speed just until combined.
Pour into a greased tin and bake at 180 °C for about 30 minutes. Let it cool.

Brigadeiro: in a pan, dissolve the milk powder in the condensed milk, add the cream and stir over medium heat until it thickens to a firm brigadeiro. Transfer to a dish, cover with cling film touching the surface and let it cool.
Jam: cook the berries with the lemon juice, sugar and a little water, stirring now and then, until thick. Cool in the fridge.
Cut the cake in half horizontally and soak it with a mix of condensed milk and water.
Spread brigadeiro and jam over the bottom half, cover with the top half and soak again.
Cover with the rest of the brigadeiro (or just dust with milk powder), wrap and chill overnight.
